summary: Design & Play in My Dollhouse with Emma's World, Family and Friends in the City
description:
You’re invited Home with Emma to play with her and all of her family and friends in her gigantic world - Emma’s World, a fun, imaginative Dollhouse game filled with interactive homes, shops, schools, hospitals, and many rooms to explore!

A fun digital dollhouse for the entire family with over 50 different venues to explore, make Emma’s Town one of the biggest pretend dollhouse games you can play for hours on end!

Create your own world with Emma in your very own home, and venture out to explore friends’ houses, shops, the grocery store, and explore everything this gigantic town has to offer! Enormous amounts of replay value await!

Create the Town of your dreams using just your imagination! Emma’s World and Town can be whatever you want it to be! Create stories, interact with characters, and create your own custom characters to make this your world! 

Emma invites you to take over her town, and bring your friends, join the party, and have fun exploring an active city with so much to do, you’ll never run out of ideas!
